{"reason":"Change the medium/high branch from alternative-supplier to internal-rebalance. V1's 34 switches cost 1,530,000 and accompany 4 stockouts (2,165,000 total). Rebalance costs 6,000 with sister stock and falls back otherwise; transfer is earlier in the medium/2.8 failure (3 versus 4 days), reducing cost without raising stockouts.","source":"(define (expedite-response risk-level inventory-days)
  (cond
    ((and (>= (risk-rank risk-level) (risk-rank 'high))
           (< inventory-days 5))
      (list 'alert-planner 'immediate-expedite-review))
    ((>= (risk-rank risk-level) (risk-rank 'medium))
      (list 'propose-internal-rebalance))
    (else (list 'monitor))))"}
